info.title: TotMart sensitive API subset
info.description: Source-aligned sensitive subset. Auth, attempt envelopes and admin refund completion have actual integration response assertions. Detailed checkout-kind results and other operations remain partial; see B05 verification. No route aliases.

post.summary: Login and create an opaque refresh family
post.description: Sensitive subset only. Identity lookup uses a 5000ms driver timeout per Mongo read; MongoOperationTimeoutError returns 503 through errorHandler, with a safe 5xx message and requestId in staging/production. This is not an end-to-end login SLA. Published 4xx mappings remain unchanged. Schema omits detailed business data; refer to current commerce contracts.
post.x-csrf: Cookie writes without Authorization require X-TotMart-Request: 1. CORS allowlist applies.
post.x-idempotency: No commerce Idempotency-Key. Login creates a new family; refresh uses persisted consumed-hash retry budget; logout revokes the current family.
post.x-retry-recovery: Login creates a new family. Failed auth is generic; do not infer account existence.

post.summary: Rotate or recover a refresh successor
post.description: Sensitive subset only. Schema omits detailed business data; refer to current commerce contracts.
post.x-csrf: Cookie writes without Authorization require X-TotMart-Request: 1. CORS allowlist applies.
post.x-idempotency: No commerce Idempotency-Key. Login creates a new family; refresh uses persisted consumed-hash retry budget; logout revokes the current family.
post.x-retry-recovery: At most two duplicates within <30s, only while the successor remains current. Reuse otherwise revokes this sid. Old token theft is indistinguishable from a retry within this policy. Absolute family expiry is 30 days, maximum 4096 consumed hashes.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required in NODE_ENV=production. Existing non-production modes (including staging) generate a key when absent; callers must always retain/send their own stable key for safe recovery. B05 preserves this source behavior.

post.summary: Record evidenced completion of a pending receipt/principal refund
post.x-csrf: Cookie writes without Authorization require X-TotMart-Request: 1.
post.x-ownership: Current DB role admin required; no merchant override. Exact pending refund amount required.
post.x-idempotency: Required key scoped by authenticated admin/action; identical command replays; different payload conflicts. Unique bank reference prevents double completion.
post.x-retry-recovery: Retry with the same key/body after lost response. Pending means liability, not transferred money. Completion requires bank evidence.
